name: Relevance
description: Measures how closely the response aligns with the context and the interesting fact provided.

name: Creativity
description: Assesses the uniqueness and originality of the response in terms of ideas and expression.

name: Clarity
description: Evaluates how clear and understandable the response is, including grammar and syntax.

name: Engagement
description: Measures how engaging and interesting the response is for the reader, including elements that provoke thought or further discussion.

name: Cohesion
description: Assesses how well the response flows and connects ideas logically, creating a coherent continuation of the conversation.
